messages:
Iris: Quick heads-up: I opened a PR to correct the /embeddings endpoint docs. The example JSON payloads in docs/examples/embeddings.yaml still use 'embedding_model' while the actual API uses 'model'. The mismatch is causing CI-generated SDK snippets to be inconsistent. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3077

Kai: Good catch. We should standardize on 'model' everywhere. I'll update the Node and Python quickstarts. Also add an explicit example showing the new 'input' vs deprecated 'text' alias.

Marco: If you change examples.yaml, ensure the OpenAPI example block is regenerated. I can run `make docs-build` and push the swagger.json artifact. Also we should add a migration note in /docs/migration/embeddings-field-changes.md.

Iris: Plan sounds good. I'll push the example updates and tests. Docs-bot, please run preview when ready.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview queued for PR #3077

Kai: One more tiny nit: the Go snippet returns a field named 'vector' in some examples and 'embeddings' in others. The canonical server response is 'embedding' (singular). Let's normalize to 'embedding' to match the SDK models. I'll align the snippets after the preview is up.

Marco: Preview passed. Merged.

Iris: Thanks team. Closing the follow-ups.
